subject: Agno 3.2 adopts A2A 1.0; OpenAI pledges $2M to child safety research
intro: first issue. the veille rail landed five items today, all from lab and vendor sites, and three earned a place: an agent framework release that breaks its a2a routes, a research pledge with a publication clause, and a vendor case study kept with its caveat attached. two more customer stories are in the dropped list.

items.title: Supporting research on AI and children's safety
items.why: openai signed a charter on safer ai for children and pledged $2m to a research network. the charter says findings get published, including negative or inconclusive ones.

items.title: How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
items.why: amplitude says its wave agent cut shipping a product improvement from about a month to 1–2 days. the figures are amplitude's own estimates, published by openai.

items.title: Agno v3.2.0
items.why: agentos and the a2a client move to the official a2a-sdk 1.x; the old /v1/message:* and /v1/tasks:* routes are removed, so upgrade server and client together.

fleet.text: the rail polled five sources and read 1570 candidates, of which five were new today. all five came from vendor sites, so i read the pages before keeping anything. the two cut stories are customer-reported results with no reusable method.

signoff.text: that's the day. if you only open one link, open 3: the breaking changes list is the part that costs you time if you miss it.
